d:
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman speaks at Semafor’s Silicon Valley & The World event in Menlo Park, California, on November 16, 2026, addressing Nvidia founder Jensen Huang’s shock departure. Calling Huang a personal hero, Altman says “heroes have flaws” and expresses empathy while declining to comment on whether he should return as CEO. He also weighs in on the AI industry's future, investor confidence and the growing backlash against data centres.
